note: Henry County Conservation Board campground in Oakland Mills Park, on the north shore of the Skunk River west of Franklin Avenue; boat ramp and the Ross Observation Tower over an 87-acre wetland. Resident host. --Claude
summary: Added fees $25 (electric sites; walk-in tent sites $15). Changed hookups water true -> false (tanks fill only, no connection); electric 50 A confirmed. Sites 25 confirmed; max_rig_ft 32 cleared (site 102 has a 62-ft drive-through pad); pull-through added. Season mid-Apr to mid-Oct, reservable on the county's rec1 catalog. Riverfront confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront confirmed. NAIP shows the Skunk River ~120 m wide at the campground. The sites sit in one row along the west (river) side of the gravel loop, ~30-40 m from the water's edge, with only a narrow riparian tree strip between; the loop road runs on the inland side. About 20 sites (the whole electric row) back onto the river. No pin change (the pin sits on the site row).
